summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K reporting standard PDMR share transactions under the UK Market Abuse Regulation. On 17 August 2026, restricted share awards under the 2024 Restricted Share Plan vested for CEO Deepak Nath; 19,492 shares were sold at £10.898231 per share to cover tax obligations, with 27,613 retained. This is a routine equity-compensation vesting and tax-related sale, not a special-situation corporate event. There are no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic implications. The filing is informational only, with no board action or deal mechanics to analyze. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; this is unrelated to any special-situations transaction.
